overview: Rainbow AI is a WhatsApp AI assistant for Pelangi Capsule Hostel & Southern Homestay. It handles guest inquiries, booking workflows, and multi-turn conversations via Baileys WebSocket. The focus is on reliability, response quality, and intent classification accuracy.
goals: Improve intent classification accuracy for booking and inquiry intents
Enhance conversation context handling for multi-turn dialogues
Add better fallback responses when AI confidence is low
Improve the booking workflow steps in workflows.json
Prioritize reliability and response quality over new features
Enforce strict business profile separation — each profile's data files must only contain content specific to that business, with zero contamination from other profiles
Fix data-makan and data-southern profiles which currently contain copy-pasted Pelangi Capsule Hostel content

epics.title: Intent Classification Accuracy
epics.description: Improve how the system classifies incoming messages into the correct intent categories, especially for booking and inquiry intents.

epics.title: Multi-Turn Conversation Context

epics.title: Fallback & Confidence Handling

epics.title: Booking Workflow Improvements
epics.description: Improve the booking workflow steps, transitions, and validation logic in workflows.json and related pipeline code.

epics.title: Test Suite Reliability
epics.description: Fix failing tests and improve test coverage for core intent and conversation logic.

epics.title: Business Profile Separation
epics.description: Ensure strict data isolation between all business profiles. Each profile's data files (knowledge.json, intents.json, intent-keywords.json, routing.json, templates.json, workflows.json) must contain ONLY content specific to that business. No profile may contain identifiers, addresses, credentials, pricing, or intents belonging to a different business.

userStories.title: Conversation Context Relevance Reranker for Multi-Turn Booking Dialogs
userStories.description: Implement message relevance scoring to filter conversation history before AI inference. Score messages by keyword overlap with current intent, reorder by relevance to prevent stale context from degrading booking classification accuracy.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `scoreMessageRelevance(message, currentIntent, profile)` in `src/assistant/pipeline/context.ts` returning 0-1 relevance score based on intent keyword overlap and recency decay
Add integration test `test/integration/multi-turn-context.test.ts` showing 10-message conversation reranked to 5 high-relevance messages before booking confirmation step
Add admin endpoint `GET /admin/context-stats?profile={profile}&days=7` returning avg context size, avg filtered size, and relevance score distribution per profile

userStories.title: Booking Workflow Step Execution Trace Logger
userStories.description: Log each booking workflow step's input, output, and execution time to enable debugging of multi-step failures. Store traces in database for post-mortem analysis and admin dashboard viewing.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `executeWorkflowStepWithTrace(step, context, profile)` in `src/assistant/workflow/executor.ts` that logs each step and saves to `booking_workflow_traces` table with schema: `booking_id, step_name, input_json, output_json, error_msg, duration_ms, created_at`
Implement admin endpoint `GET /admin/booking/:bookingId/trace` returning complete execution timeline with step outputs, errors, and durations
Add test `test/unit/workflow/execution-tracing.test.ts` asserting trace records created for 5-step workflow with correct input/output capture

userStories.title: Booking Success Funnel Analyzer with Per-Profile Conversion Tracking

acceptanceCriteria: Admin endpoint GET /admin/metrics/booking-funnel?profile=pelangi&window=7d returns {funnel: [{stage: 'intent_matched', count: 100}, {stage: 'guest_confirmed', count: 45}, {stage: 'booking_finalized', count: 12}]} with confidence scores
Daily snapshot job populates intent_analytics.booking_stage_transition table tracking guest_id, from_stage, to_stage, profile, timestamp
Dashboard shows per-profile conversion % drop between each funnel stage; targets identified for workflow improvement

userStories.title: Intent Keyword Auto-Miner from Production Misclassifications

POST /admin/keywords/approve-suggestions accepts {profile, suggestions: [{keyword, intent}]}, auto-updates src/assistant/data-{profile}/intent-keywords.json and logs change to audit trail

userStories.title: Booking Workflow Step Timeout Handler with Graceful Fallback Responses

acceptanceCriteria: Workflow step schema in src/types/workflow.ts extended: {name, action, timeoutMs?: 5000, fallbackResponse?: 'Could not verify availability. Please call reception at...'} with execution wrapper
Timeout events logged to booking_workflow_events table with step_name, elapsed_ms, timed_out_at; admin metrics endpoint tracks timeout frequency per-step
Integration test validates that step timeout triggers fallback response and guest receives message within 100ms of timeout

acceptanceCriteria: New CLI command npm run analyze:keyword-freshness /path/to/logs/ --days 30 parses production message logs and measures per-keyword match frequency
Reports output: stale_keywords.txt (keywords with zero matches in N days) and coverage_gaps.txt (new patterns not matching any intent keyword)
Test file src/__tests__/keyword-freshness.test.ts validates detection with 100+ realistic messages spanning 10 intents

Unit test validates: 15-message conversation is condensed to 1 summary + 10 recent messages while preserving all booking-critical details (room type, check-in date, guest count)

userStories.title: Add per-message cost optimization by preventing duplicate concurrent sends
userStories.description: WhatsApp switched to per-message billing on July 1, 2025. Every outbound message is now individually metered. A race condition exists in intent-classifier.ts: the 3-second 'thinking' ack timer and the main LLM response can both send messages within the same request. If the LLM responds in 2.8s, both the ack and the answer are sent. The ack should be cancelled if the main response arrives before the timer fires. Each unnecessary message is a billing charge.
acceptanceCriteria: The ackTimer in intent-classifier.ts is cleared before any response is sent from the LLM pipeline — not just after
A test with a mock LLM response time of 2.9 seconds confirms only one message is sent (the actual answer, not the ack)
A 'messages_sent_per_conversation' counter is tracked and exposed in the analytics dashboard
The admin billing dashboard adds a 'avg messages per conversation' KPI alongside cost metrics
settings.json adds documentation comment on the July 2025 per-message pricing model in the billing section
technicalNotes: Current code: ackTimer is a setTimeout at 3000ms in intent-classifier.ts — clearTimeout must be called at the start of sendResponse, not after
Reference: intent-classifier.ts lines around the ackTimer declaration and clearTimeout calls
WhatsApp utility messages in an open 24h service window are free; only proactive outbound marketing messages are charged outside the window
Source: https://www.ycloud.com/blog/whatsapp-api-pricing-update
